concept: A thick curved iron-and-leather belt with a cylindrical ironcore buckle split by a clean pale-silver mending seam. Two large riveted straps hold its core firmly. Warm amber contained in the seam, tangible protective equipment.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one original HELLSCRIPT legendary equipment icon. Metadata only, never write it in the image: LW30, Mending Ironcore, class Warrior, slot belt.
Subject design: A thick curved iron-and-leather belt with a cylindrical ironcore buckle split by a clean pale-silver mending seam. Two large riveted straps hold its core firmly. Warm amber contained in the seam, tangible protective equipment.
Power that informs materials and structure, not a spell illustration: On Iron Wall release, heal for 6% of maximum HP. Internal cooldown: 6s.
Direct skill context: W05 Iron Wall — Holds a shield worth 30% of max HP for 4 seconds.
Style: dark gothic painterly fantasy equipment, worn and chipped metal, rough leather or aged cloth, strong directional upper-left highlights, deep but readable shadows. Earthy charcoal, silver, restrained old bronze; individual restrained effect colors only within the physical object. Large shapes, few decisive details, silhouette and material structure distinguish the item. Never a flat vector symbol.
Composition and file: 1024 by 1024 pixel square PNG requested, with genuinely native transparent alpha. ONE tangible item, or ONE tightly overlapping pair for hands or feet, with no wearer. Scale the equipment down within the square: the full object should occupy only the CENTRAL 72% of canvas width and height. Keep at least 14% completely empty transparent margin on ALL FOUR sides, including above crown peaks and around both weapon tips. Do not zoom in or maximize its size. Complete object, no clipping, no missing tips. This visible empty margin is essential. Make the item strong and clear at 64px. Weapons diagonal; jewelry at three-quarter angle; other armor mostly frontal three-quarter view.
Transparency is mandatory: genuinely transparent surrounding area and internal empty holes with preserved native alpha, clean antialiased edges, no matte, no colored fringe. The image file must contain a real alpha channel; never paint a checkerboard.
Avoid: any text, letters, digits, readable runes, labels, watermark, UI frame, border, panel, badge, background, scenery, solid backdrop, gradient, floor, cast shadow, glow cloud, fog, detached particles, floating spell effects, duplicate items, collage, human body or hands. Equipment shape dominates; do not cover it with enormous effects. Do not copy any existing game icon.
